relations.description: Tidemark Lab shares testing equipment with Cedar Workshop.
Tidemark Lab provides materials training to Cedar Workshop.
Windmere Guild funds the experiments at Tidemark Lab.
Tidemark Lab audits the research records of Windmere Guild.
Amber Quay is the departure terminal for Kite Ferry.
Kite Ferry delivers fruit crates to Orchard Depot.
Orchard Depot supplies produce to Willow School.
Glass Museum hosts the collection of Silk Archive.
Glass Museum hosts the exhibits of Ember Festival.
Ember Festival holds its opening ceremony in Birch Hall.
Cedar Workshop obtains restoration timber from Reed Mill.
Reed Mill provides beams for the restoration of Slate Bridge.
Cedar Workshop repairs the wooden shelves of Opal Library.
Orchard Depot belongs to the logistics circle of Windmere Guild.
Windmere Guild administers the awards of Coral Grant.
Lunar Fund finances classroom repairs at Willow School.
Coral Grant supports the reusable material study at Tidemark Lab.
Birch Hall hosts reading outreach sessions from Opal Library.
